duplicate_rule: two invoices of the same entity with identical currency and identical line_items (description, quantity, unit_price_minor, vat_rate, service_period, po_ref) are duplicates; the later one (by issued_at instant; ties broken by due_at, then first posting time, then invoice_id) is the duplicate. Same amount with a different service_period is NOT a duplicate.
evidence: evidence_ids are ledger row_id, document doc_id or fx ids 'fx:<date>:<source>:<target>'; every cited id must exist; a finding needs a full sufficient evidence set (see task text)

finding_amounts.duplicate_invoice: AR debit posted for the duplicate invoice (base minor)
finding_amounts.fx_error: abs(posted - correct) on the AR debit row (invoice) or the cash debit row (payment), base minor
finding_amounts.payment_misallocation: sum over invoice_refs of conv(ref.amount_minor, invoice rate) minus AR credits actually posted with this payment_id (base minor)
finding_amounts.period_cutoff: AR debit posted inside the period for an invoice issued outside it (base minor)

fx.direction: rate converts 1 unit of source_currency into target_currency (=base)
fx.fallback: if no rate for that date, use the most recent earlier date present in fx.csv
fx.invoice_rate_date: calendar date of issued_at expressed in company utc_offset
fx.payment_rate_date: calendar date of payment timestamp expressed in company utc_offset

ledger.currency: all ledger rows are in base_currency
ledger.double_entry: each posting group (same timestamp + same invoice_id/payment_id) balances

postings.invoice: Dr 1200_accounts_receivable = conv(total); Cr 2200_vat_payable = conv(vat); Cr 4000_revenue = conv(total)-conv(vat)
postings.payment: Dr 1000_cash = conv(amount, payment date rate); for each invoice_refs entry Cr 1200_accounts_receivable = conv(ref.amount_minor, that invoice's rate); amount not covered by invoice_refs -> Cr 2300_unapplied_cash (converted at payment rate); remaining difference -> 7900_fx_gain_loss (Cr if gain, Dr if loss)
postings.refund: negative amount_minor; Dr 2300_unapplied_cash, Cr 1000_cash, both at conv(|amount|, refund-date rate). For a foreign-currency refund the unapplied balance (booked at the payment-date rate) can therefore keep a small base-currency residual; no 7900_fx_gain_loss row is posted for it and this is NOT an error

revenue_recognition.rule: AR and revenue are recognised at invoice issued_at. An invoice belongs to the period iff period_start <= issued_at (as an instant) <= period_end. Compare instants, not date strings.
